{{Top|leg}}
A '''portmaster''', also spelled '''port master''', was an individual responsible for supervising the operations of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. [[T. Alvak]]'s [[T. Alvak's father|father]] served as the senior port master of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial base (Tieos)|base]] on [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]] during his [[Navy/Legends|naval]] career.
